name: qiskit-framework
description: Use this skill when the user says 'Qiskit', 'QuantumCircuit', 'transpile', 'Sampler', 'Estimator', 'run on IBM Quantum', 'qiskit-aer', 'qiskit-ibm-runtime', 'execute() removed', 'migrate to Qiskit 1.0/2.0'. Builds, simulates, transpiles, and runs quantum circuits with current Qiskit (1.x/2.x) using the primitives (Sampler/Estimator V2), local Aer simulation, and IBM Quantum Runtime, including migration from removed legacy APIs. Do NOT use for: algorithm theory (quantum-computing/quantum-algorithms, grovers-algorithm, shors-algorithm), QEC simulation with Stim (quantum-computing/quantum-error-correction), or gate math basics (quantum-computing/qubits-and-gates).
